This decision overturns an earlier denial after Tesla introduced nine new California-based witnesses, which ultimately swayed the judge's decision.

title: DA Davidson Maintains A Buy Rating On Blue Bird Corporation (BLBD)
summary: DA Davidson has reiterated a buy rating on Blue Bird Corporation (BLBD), boosting its price target to $76 from $70, based on the company's strong Q1 outlook that surpassed expectations for revenues and EBITDA. The analyst noted management's conservative yet robust FY26 forecast, with significant year-over-year growth in net revenue and adjusted EBITDA in the last quarter. Blue Bird, a leading school bus manufacturer, also saw a substantial increase in EV sales, reinforcing its financial health and future prospects.

title: EXCLUSIVE: SpaceX IPO Buzz Has Space ETF Leader Fired Up — 'Would Be Exciting'
summary: The potential of a SpaceX IPO in 2026 or 2027 is generating excitement among investors and could significantly impact the Procure Space ETF (NASDAQ: UFO). According to Procure Holdings CEO Andrew Chanin, a SpaceX IPO would likely lead to the Elon Musk-led company becoming a top holding in the ETF, given its status as the largest pure-play space company. While acknowledging the potential for delays, Chanin believes such an offering would be a major development for the broader space industry.

title: Guarantor: JPMorgan Chase & Co.

title: Tesla Stock (TSLA) News Today (Dec. 22, 2025): Musk Pay Package Ruling, Robotaxi Momentum, Analyst Forecasts, and the Key Risks Ahead
summary: Tesla's (NASDAQ: TSLA) stock is trading near record highs on December 22, 2025, driven by the Delaware Supreme Court's restoration of Elon Musk's 2018 compensation plan, now valued at $139 billion, and ongoing robotaxi developments. While analyst forecasts show a wide range with many targets below current prices, the market remains focused on Tesla's long-term autonomy potential despite near-term headwinds like regulatory scrutiny from the California DMV and softer EV demand in the U.S. and Europe. Investors are closely watching Q4 delivery numbers and further robotaxi progress as key determinants for future stock movement.

title: Tesla: Delaware Supreme Court Reinstates CEO Musk’s 2018 Pay Package
summary: The Delaware Supreme Court overturned a lower court's ruling that had voided Tesla CEO Elon Musk’s 2018 pay package, causing Tesla shares to rise. Morningstar maintains its $300 fair value estimate for Tesla, viewing the shares as overvalued but noting the reinstated pay package reduces key-person risk regarding Musk's departure. The compensation package, entirely share-based, is seen as crucial for retaining Musk and aligning with his desire for increased ownership.

title: Nvidia Chip Buzz Pushes Dow, Nasdaq Up Triple Digits
summary: Technology shares, especially Nvidia, drove the Dow and Nasdaq to triple-digit gains with the S&P 500 also rising. Optimism about Nvidia's H200 chips contributed to the market's performance ahead of the holiday season, though some investors remain cautious about a "Santa Claus Rally." The article also touches on other market news, including Google's acquisition, commodity price movements, and various company-specific updates.

title: Honda to electrify N-Box in 2027 as kei EV competition builds
summary: Honda plans to launch a battery-electric version of its top-selling N-Box minicar around the 2027 financial year, intensifying competition in Japan's growing kei EV segment. While details like pricing and driving range are yet to be finalized, Honda will continue selling petrol N-Box models alongside the new EV. This move follows increasing traction for kei-class EVs in Japan, with rivals like BYD and Suzuki also set to introduce new electric kei cars.

title: Siokas buys Cosmos Health (COSM) shares worth $43,000
summary: Cosmos Health Inc. CEO Grigorios Siokas acquired 88,314 shares worth $43,000 by converting company debt into equity, increasing his direct ownership to 6,716,771 shares. This move occurs as the company, trading at $0.53, faces significant debt challenges but has shown recent resilience, with its stock gaining 17% in the past week. InvestingPro analysis suggests Cosmos Health is undervalued despite profitability challenges, and the company recently reported record Q3 2025 revenues, a strategic partnership, and a new nanotechnology program, though it also received a Nasdaq non-compliance notice regarding its minimum bid price.

title: UniFirst (UNF) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
summary: Shares of UniFirst (UNF) jumped 18.4% after the company confirmed it received an unsolicited acquisition proposal from Cintas Corporation for $275.00 per share in cash, valuing UniFirst at approximately $5.2 billion. This offer represents a significant 64% premium over the company's 90-day average closing stock price. UniFirst's Board of Directors is currently evaluating the proposal to determine the best course of action for its shareholders.

title: Factbox-Driverless future gains momentum with global robotaxi deployments
summary: The global robotaxi industry is rapidly expanding, with numerous companies testing and launching driverless services across various cities and countries. Partnerships between ride-hailing platforms and autonomous vehicle firms are driving this growth, aiming to enhance safety and reduce operational costs. Major developments include trials in the UK, Singapore, Abu Dhabi, San Francisco, Las Vegas, and several Chinese cities, with many services targeting commercial operation by 2026-2027.

title: Solar Surge: Sunrun Stock Rallies on Massive NRG Partnership and Year-End Tax Credit Rush
summary: Sunrun Inc. (NASDAQ: RUN) is experiencing a late-year stock rally, driven by a significant partnership with NRG Energy (NYSE: NRG) to create a 1-gigawatt Virtual Power Plant in Texas and an "installation rush" ahead of the December 31 federal tax credit deadline. This strategic move into grid services is positioning Sunrun for recurring revenue and long-term growth, even as the broader solar industry faces potential policy changes in 2026. The article highlights the shift in Sunrun's business model from hardware installation to a decentralized utility provider, offering a roadmap for future expansion less reliant on federal subsidies.

summary: Sunrun Inc. title: Waymo’s Disaster Helps Tesla
summary: A recent incident where Waymo's self-driving cars stalled during a San Francisco power outage has damaged its reputation as a leader in autonomous vehicle technology, creating an opportunity for Tesla. Elon Musk quickly highlighted the event, contrasting it with Tesla's self-driving capabilities and potentially boosting investor confidence in TSLA shares. This incident may shift public opinion and expert discussions in favor of Tesla's autonomous driving ambitions.

title: Wall Street Firms Cut Adobe Inc. (ADBE) Price Target but Tout Revenue Growth and Long-term Outlook
summary: Wall Street firms BMO Capital and Bernstein have reiterated "Outperform" ratings for Adobe Inc. (ADBE) despite slightly lowering price targets to $400 and $506, respectively. The decision follows Adobe's strong fourth-quarter and fiscal 2025 results, which saw record quarterly revenue of $6.19 billion and full-year revenue of $23.77 billion, surpassing expectations. Analysts are confident in Adobe's long-term outlook, projecting double-digit growth for fiscal year 2026.

title: TD Synnex stock rating reiterated at Outperform by RBC on AI growth
summary: RBC Capital has reiterated an Outperform rating on TD Synnex (NYSE:SNX) with a price target of $180. RBC anticipates a higher valuation for TD Synnex as it expands its AI infrastructure, gains Hyve customers, and achieves operating margin expansion.

title: SunCar Technology Group (NASDAQ:SDA) Receives Buy Rating from BTIG Research
summary: BTIG Research has reaffirmed a "Buy" rating for SunCar Technology Group (NASDAQ:SDA), assigning a $6.00 price target that suggests a 192.7% upside. title: Invivyd stock initiated with Buy rating at BTIG on COVID antibody potential
summary: BTIG has initiated coverage on Invivyd Inc. (NASDAQ:IVVD) with a Buy rating and a $10.00 price target, citing the company's strong antibody development track record and the significant market potential of its VYD2311 product, which is anticipated to demonstrate superiority to mRNA vaccines. The $10 target aligns with analyst consensus, reflecting Invivyd's impressive year-to-date surge of over 419% and its high gross profit margins, despite current cash burn due to product pipeline development. The company's innovative approach targets invariant regions of pathogens, with its existing PEMGARDA product already showing approximately 80% protection against COVID-19 variants in clinical studies.

title: Safe & Green Holdings (NASDAQ: SGBX) Closes Acquisition of Giant Containers
summary: Safe & Green Holdings (NASDAQ: SGBX) has completed the acquisition of Giant Containers Inc., a manufacturer of modular shipping container solutions. This strategic move expands Safe & Green's capabilities in design, engineering, sales, and project execution, aligning with its goal to become a value-added infrastructure solutions provider. The acquisition brings an established customer base, over $5 million in contracted projects, and a $22.5 million pipeline to Safe & Green.

title: England High Court Sanctions QUALCOMM Incorporated (QCOM)’s Alphawave IP Group Acquisition
summary: The High Court of Justice in England has sanctioned QUALCOMM Incorporated's acquisition of Alphawave IP Group plc, a deal valued at $2.4 billion. Cantor Fitzgerald subsequently raised Qualcomm's price target to $185, citing expectations of AI-driven demand.
